summary: DataMeds AI, Inc. (Nasdaq: MEDS) filed an 8-K on October 20, 2026, disclosing via Item 7.01 and Item 8.01 that Nasdaq's Listing Qualifications Staff confirmed in an October 19, 2026 notice that the company regained compliance with Listing Rule 5550(b)(1), the $2,500,000 minimum stockholders' equity standard. A prior April 13, 2026 deficiency letter followed a reported $(12,447,801) equity deficit for fiscal 2025 and failure of alternative tests. No transaction, price, premium, board recommendation or advisor is involved; the filing is a routine listing-compliance cure, not a special situation.
